source.description: A small crimson imp with curved horns and folded bat wings, crouched playfully, tail flicking side to side, wings twitching, grinning with glowing yellow eyes. Seamless loop.
The small crimson imp with bat wings attacks — it conjures a small flickering fireball between its claws, then hurls it toward the camera with a hop, then lands back in its crouched grinning stance.

_notes: v3 humanoid character, south direction only. Base sprite approved pre-session (character 22ea0c60, named 'Imp v2' in PixelLab); idle+attack generated via v3, self-reviewed (gate 3 pre-approved).
